title: Baked Cuban Chicken
description: This intensely flavored, lemony, baked Cuban chicken is spiced with cumin, chile pepper, and allspice. A restaurant in Florida inspired the recipe.
ingredients: 2 (8 ounce) bone-in chicken breasts, cut in half
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place chicken pieces in a large bowl. Add onion, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, allspice, onion powder, cumin, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper; stir to coat. Cover the bowl; marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour to 8 hours.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Add chicken pieces, reserving marinade in the bowl; pan-fry until browned, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to the prepared baking dish; pour reserved marinade on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until juices run clear, about 40 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into center of chicken pieces should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
